name: Transaction Report Request V 03
definition: Scope|The TransactionReportRequest message is sent by a party involved in a transaction to the matching application.|This message is used to request a report on details of transactions registered in the matching application.|Usage|The TransactionReportRequest message can be sent by either party involved in a transaction to request a report on a variety of details of all transactions that the requester is involved in. For example, the message can be used to request a report on all transactions that the requester is involved in with a certain customer.

ReportSpecification.name: Report Specification
ReportSpecification.definition: Parameters to be used as criteria for the content of the transaction report.
